item.stem:
Ishita looks at the diagram. She must bisect $\angle XOY$ with ruler and compass. Equal marks show $OA=OB$ on the arms and $AC=BC$ with ray $OC$ drawn.

Which claim correctly states what that construction produces?

options.A: Name the vertex $O$ as the bisector, and treat equal marks on the arms as unnecessary.
options.B: Say that the finished bisector ray is what creates the equal marks $OA$, $OB$, $AC$, and $BC$.
options.C: Ray $OC$ bisects $\angle XOY$, because the equal marks build congruent triangles that force the two half-angles equal.
options.D: Trace only the printed angle arc at $O$, and treat that printed mark as the bisector.
